6          M/s Floorex Tiles vs M/s Crystal Ceramic Industries
  CS No. 19 of 2024
      CNR NO. CHCH01-007863-2024
  
M/s Floorex Tiles    vs      M/s Crystal Ceramic Industries 
Present: Sh. Subodh Walia, counsel for the applicant/plaintiff. 
Arguments heard. 
Vide separate order of even date  an application under Order
23 rule 1 CPC alongwith order 7 rule 10 CPC, order 30 rule 7(2), Section
16 of Court Fees Act etc filed by the applicant/plaintiff stands allowed.
The instant suit stands dismissed as withdrawn, with a permission to the
applicant/plaintiff to file fresh suit on same cause of action. The original
documents be returned to the applicant/plaintiff. Necessary certificate
regarding refund of court fee be also issued. 
File be consigned to the record room. 
Pronounced in open Court
    Ashwani Kumar,
08.01.2025
          ADJ-Cum-Presiding Judge
Commercial Court, Chandigarh
     HR01016
Ashwani Kumar,
ADJ-Cum-Presiding Judge
Commercial Court, Chandigarh
HR0106/08.01.2025
SHALU
